Other amenities are thoughtful too: a washing machine is available (though chargeable), a dedicated smoking area where you can relax and chill with friends, and a common TV area with free access to Netflix, YouTube, and more for unwinding. Towels and locks are available for rent if needed.
The owner is friendly and approachable, and they even offer monthly stays with direct negotiation for better rates – perfect for longer-term visitors.

There are some reasonable rules in place, like no cooking or noise in the kitchen area after 11 AM (to avoid disturbing others sleeping nearby), no smoking area access after 1 AM, restrictions on the TV area late at night (around 2:30-4 AM), and no gathering at the entrance gate after 1 AM. These rules are genuinely fair and help maintain a peaceful environment for everyone – no complaints there!

Overall, This Hostel offers great value with its prime location, practical facilities, and considerate management. It's ideal for solo travelers, backpackers, or anyone looking for a comfortable, no-fuss stay in Mumbai. I thoroughly enjoyed my time here and would definitely return!
